title: Right-rail pager: a giant wide numeral cut to its top 55%, the '// 02 / 05' line on a ground plate, the screen name in wide caps
use: The fixed screen pager in the right rail of a paged site or a game menu. current and total are two-digit numbers.

numeral.note: drawn from current; decoration (cut to its top 55%)

relations: Numeral 86.4 units in a 47.5-unit window, right edge 38 units in.
The small line sits 13 units below the numeral's top, over its right half, on a ground plate.
Screen name 16-18 units, 10% tracking, right-aligned under the window.
decoration: The rail hairline and the numeral: drawn.

provenance.corpus: fogwake case (雾航信标 FOGWAKE): our own original game site and two in-game screens in the lattice-dossier grammar
provenance.experiment: styles/lattice-dossier/style.json provenance (official site captured and measured privately; never shipped)
provenance.method: computed style of the reference pager: numeral 86.4 px with a 47.52 px line box, '// 02 / 05' 18 px, name 18 px at 1.8 px tracking
measured: Reference: right edge x 1882, numeral top y 480 on inner screens, y 398 on the first.
Case: the plate keeps the small line at 4.5:1 over the numeral.
